name: controlled-process-boundary
description: Controlled provider process boundary (src/providers/process.ts, trellis-eddc): Bun.spawn throws ENOENT/EACCES synchronously with .code (classify missing-executable vs startup-failed); spawn with detached:true + process.kill(-pid,'SIGKILL') kills the whole POSIX process group so killed provider runs leave no orphan descendants (a grandchild holding the inherited stdout pipe otherwise blocks stream EOF); Bun.spawn resolves bare executable names against the *child's* env, so resolved executables must be absolute paths (Bun.execPath does not exist in Bun 1.2 — use process.execPath) and env:{} gives the child exactly the explicit map with nothing inherited.

name: staged-provider-source-view
description: Staged provider source view (src/providers/workspace.ts + staging.ts/context.ts/staged-run.ts, trellis-2fe6): realpath-resolve BOTH sides before containment checks (root and file) so aliased roots (macOS /var vs /private/var) neither escape nor false-reject; expose canonical scratch paths to providers. Owned scratch cleanup must be reportable without masking the original outcome — makeCleanup returns a CleanupStatus instead of throwing, and withStagedWorkspaceView carries adapter value/error in structured outcomes. mkdtemp-created scratch must be cleaned INSIDE createScratch when a post-creation check (tmpdir-inside-root) throws, or the caller's catch never sees the path and leaks it. Bash rm on a self-loop symlink actually succeeds (unlinks it) — force cleanup failures in tests with a chmod 0o500 dir holding a child instead, or via TMPDIR pointing at a missing dir for mkdtemp failures (os.tmpdir() re-reads TMPDIR per call in Bun).

title: SonarJS executable support stays explicitly deferred; capability metadata is the typed carrier
rationale: The pinned eslint-plugin-sonarjs 3.0.5 distribution carries conflicting license evidence (LGPL-3.0-only package metadata vs SONAR Source-Available License v1.0 shipped headers), so no distribution route can be inferred and no legal opinion is obtainable in-repo. Record DEFERRED with the concrete clearance prerequisite tracked in seeds (trellis-7f5d), and encode the outcome structurally: src/providers/capabilities.ts uses z.literal for unscored/requestState 'unsupported'/outcome 'deferred' so drifted or overclaiming metadata fails schema parse at module load. The metric adapter (threshold-zero diagnostic parsing) is explicitly not a stable API; the recorded access strategy for any cleared route lives in docs/sonarjs-decision.md alongside the preserved six metric + six bug controls cross-checked against the spike fixtures.

content: src/providers/process.ts sits at exactly 400 lines (the file-size threshold). Any step extending the executable registry (e.g. trellis-f4e2 jscpd adapter) must split the module rather than adding lines — check:size fails above 400 and budgets may not be raised.

name: jscpd-adapter-raw-evidence-boundary
description: The jscpd adapter (src/providers/jscpd/, trellis-f4e2): run the pinned 5.2.1 binary only through resolve.ts->process.ts over a staged view; explicit empty --config blocks jscpd's ancestor .jscpd.json discovery and --no-gitignore blocks gitignore filtering; statistics.total.sources counts only files at/above --min-tokens (below-threshold files are omitted from the tool's own accounting), so the adapter records a selected/reported/omitted coverage account and marks a mode complete only when sources===selected (per-file coverage otherwise not enumerable from provider evidence); a directory occupying the report path makes the json reporter exit 1 ('Reporter json error') — a deterministic real provider-error trigger for tests; kind-per-mode is exact:[exact], normalized:[exact,renamed], near:[exact,renamed,similar] with method/similarity only on similar (empirical from docs/research/jscpd-provider-spike).
